rating.comments: Student messages are one or two words each: 'socializing', 'learning and flirting', 'cyber bullying', 'yes less physical activity'. These name items with no reasons or steps, so reasoning is at most a single bare point (2). Items partly echo the tutor's prompts (e.g. learning, physical activity), which earns knowledge_building 2 rather than higher. No questions were asked. The student never answered the request for an overall opinion, so effort is fragmentary with no complete attempt (2).
